# DC Anatomy Clean

> [!mechanic]
> **Contact poison.** Bare-skin contact on a coated surface: DC 12 CON save or poisoned for 10 minutes. Gloves negate.

| Type | Delivery | Effect | DC | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contact secretion | Bare skin on coated surface | Poisoned 10 min | 12 CON | Environmental |
| Weapon poison | Arrow or dagger hit | Poisoned 1 min | 12 CON | All combatants |

> [!check] Perception — The Loose Floorboard
> DC 15; anyone searching the rear wall may roll.
> **Success:** the cache is found.
> **Failure:** nothing is noticed.

**Combat calibration.** AC 16, HP 88, five attacks per round.
